title: Matt Rife's Haunted Seymour Rental Has An Exorcism Room — And A $999 Price Tag

content:
A séance parlor, an exorcism room, a bedroom called the "Doll Room," and a history dark enough to attract the ghost hunters behind "The Conjuring." And now, you can spend the night there.

Comedian Matt Rife, YouTuber Josh Yozura, and Shelton-born influencer Elton Castee have purchased a Connecticut home known as the "Hell House," a property once investigated by the famed paranormal investigators who inspired "The Conjuring" films.

The five-bedroom home at 89 Buckingham Rd., in Seymour sold for $400,000 on Monday, Oct. 5, according to a real estate listing. Built in 1900, the 2,216-square-foot house sits on a 1.31-acre lot.

Rife, Yozura, and Castee announced the purchase in a joint social media post, revealing plans to open the property for paranormal investigations and overnight stays.

Stay the night at HELL HOUSE, or buy HELL HOUSE merch and own a piece of the actual haunted house here: https://hauntedhellhouse.com/

Exploring With Josh

"We officially bought one of the most infamous haunted houses ever investigated by Ed & Lorraine Warren, the ghost hunters who inspired The Conjuring films," the post says. "Yet this house has a dark, twisted and terrifying history, leading to an exorcism performed within the home..."

The house, which was also featured on the Discovery Channel, is now available for overnight paranormal investigations.

The price of a potentially sleepless night? Anywhere from $666 to $999.

According to the haunted house's website, private overnight rentals cost $666 Monday through Thursday, $888 on Sundays, and $999 on Fridays and Saturdays. Rates are per night, not per person.

And this isn't your typical vacation rental. According to the haunted house's website, the fully restored property comes with a séance parlor, scrying room, basement, and a kitchen that doubles as an exorcism room.

Then there are the bedrooms. Guests can choose from the master bedroom, red bedroom, spiritual sanctuary bedroom, brothel room, and doll room. The rental sleeps up to eight people, who get private access to the entire house and grounds, along with paranormal investigation equipment.

For those who prefer their ghost hunting with modern comforts, the property also has Wi-Fi, heating, air conditioning, and two full bathrooms, according to the rental listing. There are rules, though.

No candles, incense, fires, or open flames are allowed. Guests must be at least 18 to book, and minors must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian. Check-in begins at 4 p.m., and checkout is at noon. The rental is accepting reservations, with select November dates available as of Friday, Nov. 20.

Whether the ghosts show up is another question entirely.
